answer: Picture a reputation atlas where every identity is an island that must stay connected to the mainland of honest behavior: each epoch, agents publish a signed dawn checkpoint proving liveness, and islands that miss two checkpoints in a row are quarantined automatically. A sybil attacker spinning up thousands of fake islands must keep every single one of them active and checkpointing, so the cost of maintaining the fake archipelago grows with each identity while honest agents pay almost nothing. Quarantined islands lose their staked deposits, making fake fleets economically self-defeating.
